q: Locked out of a padlocked Ayresome Park as the club fought liquidation, Middlesbrough staged their first home fixture of the 1986-87 season at another club's ground. Which one?
hint: Hartlepool United lent Boro their ground for the Port Vale game on 23 August 1986, three weeks after the gates were padlocked and thirty non-playing staff, Bruce Rioch among them, were sacked.

q: Who was Middlesbrough's manager for the 2006 UEFA Cup final against Sevilla?
hint: Steve McClaren took charge in June 2001, and the Eindhoven final was his last game for Boro: the FA had named him England's next manager on 4 May, six days before the final, and he left the club on 11 May, the day after the 4-0 defeat. Robson (1994-2001), Southgate (appointed June 2006) and Strachan (2009-10) all managed Middlesbrough, but none of them was in the dugout that night.

q: Which Italian striker joined Middlesbrough from Juventus in 1996, just weeks after scoring in that year's Champions League final?
hint: Fabrizio Ravanelli put Juventus ahead against Ajax in Rome, then arrived on Teesside for around £7m and scored a hat-trick on his league debut in a 3-3 draw with Liverpool.

q: Then club-record signing Afonso Alves scored a hat-trick in an 8-1 home win on the final day of the 2007-08 season — against which club?
hint: Manchester City were dismantled at the Riverside in May 2008. Alves had arrived from Heerenveen that January for what was then a club-record fee of around £12.5m.

q: The last competitive match at Ayresome Park, in April 1995, was a 2-1 win that sealed the Division One title. Who were the visitors?
hint: John Hendrie scored both goals — the last competitive goals at the old ground — as Boro went up as champions before the move across town.

q: Academy graduate Stewart Downing left Middlesbrough in 2009 in a deal worth up to £12m — which club did he join?
hint: Downing moved to Aston Villa after relegation, later playing for Liverpool and West Ham. He returned to his boyhood club in 2015 for a reported £5.5m.

q: Juninho left Middlesbrough after their 1997 relegation from the Premier League — which Spanish club did he join?
hint: Atlético Madrid took him to the Vicente Calderón, and it was from there that he returned to Teesside on loan in 1999-2000.

q: Which Australian striker did Middlesbrough sign from Leeds United in 2004?
hint: Mark Viduka cost £4.5m and scored twice in the 4-1 second-leg win over Basel during the UEFA Cup run. He left for Newcastle United on a free in 2007.

q: In 1989 Middlesbrough sold Gary Pallister for £2.3m, at the time a British record fee for a defender. Which club bought him?
hint: Pallister had just been relegated with Boro that summer; at Old Trafford he went on to form a title-winning centre-back partnership with Steve Bruce.

q: Middlesbrough played at which ground for more than 90 years before moving to the Riverside Stadium in 1995?
hint: Ayresome Park was Boro's home from 1903 and hosted its last competitive game in April 1995; the club began the following season at the newly built Riverside Stadium on the town's old dockland.
